title: Beautiful and empty
body: Best looking tracker I have used. It records what I did and never suggests what to do next, so I stopped opening it.

title: Needs Health Connect
body: Android has Health Connect now. Without it I am typing my Fitbit workouts in twice.

title: Lost my first three days
body: Logged as a guest, signed up, everything but one entry disappeared. Uninstalled.

title: Cannot upload a photo
body: Avatar upload fails on iPhone. Works if I screenshot the photo first which is absurd.

title: Premium is vapour
body: Subscription screen lists six premium features then tells you subscriptions are coming soon.

title: Presque parfait
body: Interface superbe. Il manque le mode hors ligne et les rappels.

title: Dark mode is unreadable
body: Dark purple numbers on a black card. Whoever picked those tokens never used it outside.

title: Not accessible
body: VoiceOver reads the weekly progress ring as an empty group. Blind users cannot use the primary screen.

title: Where are the charts
body: No weight trend, no weekly graph, no insight. Just today.

title: Slow history
body: Exercise history takes about eight seconds to load a single week. Feels like it queries each day separately.

title: Add streaks
body: Genuinely pleasant to use. Add a streak counter and reminders and it is a daily habit.

title: Web wrapper feel
body: No widget, no notifications, no offline. Publish real native apps.

title: Records, never coaches
body: Lovely interface. It will happily store the same workout forty times and never once suggest progressing. No plan, no weekly summary.

title: Stone and pounds please
body: UK user here. Kilograms only is a strange choice for a consumer fitness app in 2026.

title: Where is the monthly view
body: Week at a time, forever. I cannot see a month, cannot export, cannot show my physio anything.
